dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth and continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are symmetrical and smooth with no observable bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; characterized by a high-intensity median pixel value across the entire visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent, high-contrast dark longitudinal line is visible along the central axis of the posterior dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated, dark-pigmented mark or linear scar is located on the midline of the lower dorsal area.
